title: Pipi Labu
description: A resource pack that remodel current Minecraft wolf into famous meme "Pipi Labu". Utilize the features of Optifine (ETF & EMF) with custom sound effects
body:
# Pipi Labu

> A resource pack that remodels Minecraft's wolf into the famous **Pipi Labu** meme.

![All the Dawgs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7950721e2fba603f193f7176615cbf7363a98a0b_0.webp)

Transform your loyal companion into **Pipi Labu**, featuring a fully custom 3D model, expressive animations, custom sound effects, and handcrafted equipment. Built with **Entity Model Features (EMF)** and **Entity Texture Features (ETF)**, the pack blends naturally into Minecraft while giving wolves a fun new personality.

---

## Features

- Fully remodeled Pipi Labu wolf
- Custom 3D model
- Smooth custom animations
- Custom sound effects
- Custom sword and shield
- Vanilla-friendly art style
- Client-side resource pack

---

## Requirements

This pack requires one of the following:

- Entity Model Features (EMF) + Entity Texture Features (ETF)
- OptiFine with Custom Entity Models enabled

---

## Installation

1. Install EMF and ETF (or OptiFine).
2. Place **Pipi Labu** into your Resource Packs folder.
3. Enable the resource pack.
4. Enjoy your new companion.

---

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.21+
- Client-side only
- Multiplayer compatible

---
